summary: saeka CLI deploys XRay proxy on installer's GCP with shared hardcoded credentials and registers the deployment URL to an author-controlled tracker
details: The saeka CLI provisions an XRay multi-protocol proxy (Trojan/VMess/VLESS/Shadowsocks) as a public --allow-unauthenticated Cloud Run service on the installer's own GCP project, configuring all four inbounds with the shared hardcoded password/id 'saeka'. setup.sh then fetches a GitHub token from a mutable Pastebin URL (pastebin.com/raw/7rAmCXDp) into ~/.gh_token, uses that token to clone https://github.com/qkc404/saeka-gcp-panel, appends the installer's deployed Cloud Run hostname to host.txt, and pushes it back to the author's repository. The combination — a shared universal password across every installer's proxy, plus automatic registration of each deployed endpoint into a public author-controlled index — makes every installer's GCP-billed proxy directly reachable and usable by the author or anyone who reads that repository. The Pastebin-hosted GitHub token is a mutable third-party credential distributed to every installer; rotating the Pastebin content changes what credential lands on installer disks and what repository is pushed to. None of this behavior is meaningfully disclosed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
